| Step | Action | Why it matters |
|------|--------|----------------|
| 1 | **Lock all doors** (`lockDoors`) | Keeps the vehicle secure while you’re inside and prevents accidental opening. |
| 2 | **Press the brake pedal** (`pressBrakePedal`) | Most vehicles require the brake to be engaged before the engine can start, ensuring safety and preventing unintended movement. |
